reason: Releasing is not publishing (2026-10-13). A stable release (scripts/foundry-release.sh stable) is cut once the default API host answers; this marker stays false until that release has been installed from the stable manifest into a live Foundry and passed the e2e suites.
precondition: scripts/foundry-mark-published.sh succeeds: installs the stable manifest's download zip into a live Foundry v14 and passes the UI, scripting-API (incl. notes check) and pairing e2e suites, then writes published=true
note: Only scripts/foundry-mark-published.sh flips `published`. A release existing is not the same as a module installing.
